narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Four panas make a dramma, so one pana is one quarter of a dinar.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But four panas make a dramma, and not a dinar.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A dinar is twelve drammas, so a dramma is a small part of it.
